title: kernel-v1 durability integration test constants (v1)
description: Versioned source of truth for the numeric and policy constants that govern the durability integration test suite (tests/durability/). Every constant the test scripts read is anchored here; any number not anchored here is a plan defect. Tests run against live infrastructure: PostgreSQL 16, Kafka KRaft (single broker), ClickHouse 24.8. Delivery semantics: at-least-once with declared duplicates only. No cross-session exactly-once claim.

message_count.description: Number of messages to produce in the Kafka idempotent producer test. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#message_count.

produce_timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for Kafka produce operations. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#produce_timeout_ms.

consume_timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for Kafka consume operations. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#consume_timeout_ms.

pg_max_connections.description: PostgreSQL max_connections setting. The pool exhaustion test opens connections up to this limit. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#pg_max_connections.

pg_pool_exhaustion_reserve.description: Number of connections to reserve below max_connections for superuser/monitoring. The pool exhaustion test targets (max_connections - reserve). Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#pg_pool_exhaustion_reserve.

pg_statement_timeout_ms.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds for PostgreSQL test queries. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#pg_statement_timeout_ms.

ch_events_ttl_days.description: ClickHouse events_v1 TTL in days. The TTL enforcement test verifies the _ttl_expires_at column is set to now() + this interval. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#ch_events_ttl_days.

ch_dlq_ttl_days.description: ClickHouse events_dlq_v1 TTL in days. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#ch_dlq_ttl_days.

ch_dedup_merge_wait_s.description: Maximum seconds to wait for ClickHouse background merge to collapse ReplacingMergeTree duplicates before falling back to FINAL. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#ch_dedup_merge_wait_s.

kafka_topic_partitions.description: Number of partitions for the durability test topic. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#kafka_topic_partitions.

kafka_replication_factor.description: Replication factor for the durability test topic. Single broker dev infra uses 1. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#kafka_replication_factor.

kafka_acks.description: Producer acks setting. MUST be 'all' for the idempotent producer. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#kafka_acks.

kafka_consumer_group_count.description: Number of consumers in the consumer group rebalance test. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#kafka_consumer_group_count.

outbox_retry_count.description: Number of retry attempts for the outbox publish-then-delete cycle. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#outbox_retry_count.

delivery_semantics.description: Delivery semantics under test. At-least-once with declared duplicates only. No cross-session exactly-once claim. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#delivery_semantics.

test_prefix.description: Prefix for all test tables, topics, and consumer groups. Ensures cleanup targets only test artifacts. Anchored as bench/schemas/durability.v1.json#test_prefix.
